review_notes: I read the whole file. Its main definitions are regDirichletDensity, complexDirichletDensity, regDirichletIntegral and complexDirichletIntegral. I grepped Mathlib for Dirichlet density and integral names. The only hit was NumberField/DirichletDensity.lean, which is about the density of sets of primes and is unrelated. Mathlib has no complex or regularized Dirichlet density on the simplex. A grep for stdSimplexInterior and coordinateSet in Mathlib found nothing, so the simplex interior is not a competing copy of a Mathlib definition. The integrals are thin wrappers around Mathlib's set integral, which is a deliberate named API. They are not separate versions of an existing concept. I found no justified duplication, so I abstain. I did not read the repo's own sibling files in detail, such as the Integral.Complex file, because the rubric concerns concepts already in Mathlib.
